# UNIVMAR — universmarbre.com

> UNIVMAR is a Moroccan marble and natural stone company (founded 2004, workshop in Temara). We source from local quarries, import premium marble and granite, fabricate to spec, and deliver nationwide for architects, interior designers, developers, and contractors.

## Contact

- Phone: +212 660-419991
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/212660419991
- Email: contact@universmarbre.com
- Address: Atelier 2, Ouled Slama, Ain Atiq, Temara, Morocco
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/univers.marbre/
- Primary language: French. Also available in English and Arabic.

## Company

- [About UNIVMAR](https://universmarbre.com/fr/a-propos): History, vision, workshop capabilities, and 20+ years of experience in marble and natural stone in Morocco.
- [Contact & quote request](https://universmarbre.com/fr/contact): Request a quote for marble, granite, Taza stone, onyx, or quartz. Visit the Temara workshop or call for samples.
- [Projects & references](https://universmarbre.com/fr/projets): Completed work including Mall Le Caroussel, UM6P, and high-end residential projects.

## Products

- [Product catalogue](https://universmarbre.com/fr/produits): 80+ stones — local Moroccan marble, Taza stone (beige and grey), imported marble, granite, onyx, slate, and quartz. Prices on request (MAD).
- Categories: local marble, natural stone & Taza stone, imported marble, granite, onyx, quartz.

## Expertise guides

- [Marble in Morocco](https://universmarbre.com/fr/marbre-maroc): Local and imported marble supplier; finishes, applications, and delivery across Morocco. Target keyword: marbre maroc.
- [Taza stone](https://universmarbre.com/fr/pierre-de-taza): Beige and grey Taza stone for façades, terraces, pools, and cladding — UNIVMAR specialty. Target keyword: pierre de taza.
- [Taza marble](https://universmarbre.com/fr/marbre-de-taza): Beige Taza and Grey Taza local marble for floors, halls and bathrooms. Target keyword: marbre de taza.
- [Marble prices Morocco](https://universmarbre.com/fr/prix-marbre-maroc): Prix marbre Maroc, prix marbre m², prix granit m² — indicative ranges and quote factors. Commercial intent.
- [Marble kitchen worktops](https://universmarbre.com/fr/plan-de-travail-marbre): Plan de travail marbre cuisine, custom cut marble/granite worktops.
- [Natural stone in Morocco](https://universmarbre.com/fr/pierre-naturelle-maroc): Overview of Moroccan natural stone for architecture and landscaping.
- [Granite in Morocco](https://universmarbre.com/fr/granit-maroc): Granite for kitchens, floors, façades, and high-traffic surfaces.
- [Local Moroccan marble](https://universmarbre.com/fr/marbre-local-maroc): Marble from Taza, Khénifra, Azilal, Benslimane, and other Moroccan quarries.
- [Imported marble](https://universmarbre.com/fr/marbre-importe): Italian, Spanish, Greek, and Brazilian marble selection.
